about.title: About you
about.lede: Just the basics. Nobody sees this until you're in a confirmed pod together.
about.firstNameHelp: Only people in a confirmed pod with you see it.
about.dobHelp: We check that you're 18 or older, then keep only your birth year, to match people of similar ages.
about.dobInvalid: That is not a valid date.
about.underage: Grouper is only for people aged 18 and over.
about.legalLinks: Read the <terms>Terms</terms>. How we handle your data is in the <privacy>privacy notice</privacy>.

area.title: Where do you live?
area.lede: Pods meet near home. Your phone turns this into an area of about 5 km before anything is sent.
area.locationFailed: We could not get your approximate location. Use your postcode instead.
area.storedNote: We store only this area, never your address or exact location. Nobody is ever shown how far away you live.
area.outsideHint: You can still sign up; we'll tell you when we open near you.
area.underage: Grouper is only for people aged 18 and over. We have deleted your sign-in and kept nothing else about you.

heardFrom.question: Where did you hear about Grouper?
heardFrom.hint: We only count the answers per city and week; it is not saved on your profile.
heardFrom.venuePoster: A poster at a café or venue

interests.title: What are you into?
interests.lede: In your own words, Danish or English. Pods form around one thing you all share.

prefs.title: Who would you like to meet?

final.title: Almost done
final.photoTitle: A photo, so your pod recognises you
final.photoBody: Only people in a confirmed pod with you can see it. In pods about a private interest, you choose per pod.
final.notifBody: Notifications only say things like “Your weekly drop is here”. Never who is in a pod or what it is about.
final.notifOff: Notifications are off. You can turn them on later in Settings.
final.pledge: I'll meet in public places, treat people with respect, and use Report if something feels wrong.

photo.uploaded: Thanks! Your photo will appear shortly.
photo.failed: The upload did not work. You can add a photo later.

prefs.agesHint: Starts around your own age. Everyone in a pod fits everyone else's range.
prefs.ageRangeTooNarrow: The age range must span at least 5 years.
prefs.openToAnyoneHint: If no interest fits, you can be matched with nearby people without a shared theme.
prefs.sameGenderHint: We'll ask for your gender and your consent, and use it only for this.

gender.title: Same-gender pods
gender.question: Your gender
gender.pick: Pick your gender to see how we use it.
gender.englishOnly: This text is only available in English for now.

aboutMe.intro: Optional: one sentence about you. Only people in a confirmed pod with you see it, and it is never used for matching.
aboutMe.label: About me
aboutMe.placeholder: For example: New in town, always up for a long walk
aboutMe.helper: Shown to confirmed pod members. Not used for matching.
aboutMe.CONTACT_INFO: No contact details here: you haven't met yet. Share them in person if you like.
aboutMe.BLOCKLIST: This contains words that aren't allowed on Grouper.

waitlist.title: {{city}} opens soon
waitlist.next: We're aiming for {{goal}} people in {{city}} before we open the city. Your first drop is the Thursday after, at 18:00. We'll send you a notification.
waitlist.shareBody: Know someone who'd like to meet new people? Every person who joins brings your first pod closer.
waitlist.shareMessage: Grouper forms small groups of people near you around a shared interest. Join the waitlist for {{city}}: {{link}}
